messages:
anya: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

anya: Did a canary of the slot rebalancer after landing the alignment patch. Noticed p95 creep (~38ms -> 43ms) on batchy workloads. Throughput unchanged. Saving raw logs to /mnt/logs/canary/slot-rebalance-1724.

mike: ugh. do you have raw numbers (before/after) and the bench command?

anya: before 38ms, after 43ms on 512-token median seq. bench command: `./bench --suite=batchy --seq=512 --runs=60`. Eviction rate looked elevated; saw tail variance when eviction >0.7/sec.

ciara: is this related to the eviction thrash we saw last week or different signal?

anya: different commit — this was the slot alignment change (pack ordering). I toggled `slot_alignment` and `batch_pack_threshold` during canary.

tj: pinging @eng-sre for telemetry — ops-bot can you pull eviction & disk IO for canary hosts around the run?

ops-bot: eviction-rate: average=0.68/sec, peak=1.2/sec across canary pool. disk-io spikes logged at 2026-03-17T22:05:02Z.

mike: thanks. can you paste the quick kernel config diff that was applied?

anya: sure:
```
# quick config diff
slot_alignment: true -> false
slot_window: 20 -> 16
batch_pack_threshold: 0.75 -> 0.85
```

ciara: my hypothesis: tighter packing increases per-request scheduling variance for some shards, causing p95 tail to shift when combined with eviction churn. Suggest try smaller slot_window for canary.

anya: starting a rerun with `slot_window=12` and `--batch-size=8`. Will post results.

anya: also opened a tiny revert PR for the alignment change: https://git.internal/r/1234 — PTAL @mike @tj

mike: will review later today.

tj: blocker for me: need the canary bench-report by EOD for the SLO summary. anya can you attach `bench-report.json` to the PR?

anya: just added bench-report.json and a short note in the PR. quick summary: p50 unchanged, p95 +13%, p99 +5%. Full artifacts attached.

ciara: please also attach KV telemetry snapshot (TTL churn / eviction histogram) — looks correlated.

anya: done, included `kv-telemetry-snapshot.json` in the PR artifacts. TTL churn peaked during IO spike window.

mike: one quick q — are these runs using continuous batching or microbatch packer?

anya: microbatch packer v2 (pack-v2). Noted an intermittent fallback to pack-v1 for tiny requests on one canary host — prob infra flake. Investigating.

tj: ok. next steps: (1) anya: rerun with slot_window=12 and post numbers; (2) mike: review PR; (3) ciara: double-check eviction heuristics; (4) I'll coordinate with eng-sre for a follow-up canary with adjusted config.

anya: no other blockers from my side.

ciara: fyi if rerun confirms packing as root cause I'll schedule a 15m quick sync after results.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll 1724 -> revert slot_alignment true->false at 1724890300 by anya

mike: :thumbsup:
